correctness.rationale: A relative basis of g regular 1-forms is established by valuations and smooth base change. The Cartier expansion and the residue condition i+t+s=p-1 are exact for all odd p. Constant invertible row/column scalings yield Hankel blocks with valuations t² for t-minors; a nonzero factorial Vandermonde determinant proves each lower bound sharp since 2t-1<p. The blocks cover all nonzero entries, so the Smith profile follows universally. Direct binomial verifier rerun independently for eight small odd primes.

value.rationale: This determines a natural deformation invariant, the Fitting profile of relative Frobenius as a Hermitian fibre specializes, uniformly in every odd characteristic. At p≥7 the higher odd powers detect infinitesimal order invisible to all known fibre rank and a-number calculations: e.g. p=7 has five first-order factors and one third-order factor. The complete natural infinite-family classification informs scheme-theoretic degeneracy/flattening and separates set-theoretic jump strata from their thickness; not an arbitrary finite sample.
